items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: That's his night off. He's one of our best saxophone players.

ctx.x: Gee, he ought to be able to make some more recordings now. Yeah, he's getting along with it. What does he do when he makes a record? He takes the night off and pays somebody to come and make a play? Some of them come and work for him.
Sometimes this lady had a recording, God couldn't know what he did he got there. The last recording, he was lucky it was on Tuesday. That's his night off. He's one of our best saxophone players.
I don't believe that he would get as tired playing the sax as you would the trumpet. No.
